title: Freeze scene-graph, traversal-graph, and environment-spec schemas v1.0
summary: Define and freeze the three data contracts the scene-graph service produces and the Unity runtime and validator consume. Freeze needs an AUTH (design-change); later changes need another.

acceptance_tests.test: data/schemas/scene_graph.json, traversal_graph.json, and environment_spec.json (JSON Schema 2020-12) define surfaces (Bible §4 classes), measurements in A units, the scale multiplier, edges (which surface reaches which by which verb at what difficulty), and the summit/routes/vistas spec with a per-segment beat.
Fixtures validate; at least one invalid fixture per schema is rejected; the validator and a Unity loader both parse the same fixture.
The PR cites APPROVED #n for the freeze; data/schemas/README.md records version 1.0.0 and the change rule.
Reviewed by gj-gameplay (runtime consumer) and gj-platform (packaging).

auth_required.what: Freeze scene_graph / traversal_graph / environment_spec schemas v1.0.0

history.event: Draft ready (gj-operator): design/proposals/m1-data-01-schemas/ holds scene_graph / traversal_graph / environment_spec v1.0.0 (JSON Schema 2020-12; Bible §4 classes, §9 materials, A units; verb→tier table per SPEC §3.4; margin 0.85; beats introduce→develop→twist→resolve with beat 1 T0-only; template fallback; package-relative assets), check_consistency.py (cross-document rules), a synthetic desk fixture set + 15 invalid fixtures, 51 pytest cases. Freeze AUTH request filed (governance/auth-requests/M1-DATA-01-schema-freeze.md). → blocked on the AUTH + AT-4 review

AT-4 secondary review (Coordinator, AUTH #027) + freeze under AUTH #037. Review found one BLOCKER: the teach-before-use consistency check only fired on the rank-1 route (`tool is None and tools and route["rank"] == 1`), so a harder ranked route could use a tool without declaring required_tool. Fixed to `tool is None and tools` (all routes). Schemas frozen as-drafted otherwise; two field items surfaced to the Owner as non-blocking fast-follows (crouch=T0 extends SPEC §3.4; vault names speed/kong/lazy to reconcile in M1-MOVE-02). Files moved unchanged from design/proposals/m1-data-01-schemas/ to data/schemas/environment/ (kept as a self-contained subdir so its fixture globbing does not collide with the flat telemetry/correction fixtures). 51 environment tests + 70 telemetry/correction tests all green together; standalone check_consistency.py reports consistent on the valid triple. data/schemas/README.md version rows added. AT-1..AT-4 all met. blocked → done.
